{{Current events header|2015|08|2}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**A [[Saudi Arabia]]n citizen is killed in the city of [[Najran]] by a projectile fired from [[Yemen]]. [http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2015/08/02/Saudi-citizen-killed-in-Yemen-border-shelling.html (Al-Arabiya)]
*[[Turkey–PKK conflict]]
**A suicide attack by the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party|PKK]] kills two [[Turkish Army]] soldiers and injures 24 in the [[Turkey|Turkish]] town of [[Doğubeyazıt]] in [[Ağrı Province]] near the [[Iran]] border. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-33750803 (BBC)]
*General Adolphe Nshimirimana, former chief of staff of the [[Military of Burundi|Burundi Army]], is assassinated in [[Bujumbura]]. [http://www.rfi.fr/contenu/ticker/burundi-ancien-chef-etat-major-armee-ete-assassine-officiel (RFI original in French)]
*[[Boko Haram]]
**[[Nigerian Army]] soldiers rescue 178 people from Boko Haram camps including 101 children. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/44bf185562a14cf88c56de5f040b3f6b/nigeria-troops-rescue-178-people-destroy-extremist-camps (AP)]
;Law and crime
* A court in [[Republic of Egypt|Egypt]] postpones a verdict in the prominent trial of two journalists with [[Al-Jazeera]], who have been charged with aiding the [[Muslim Brotherhood]]. [http://www.reuters.com/article/2015/08/02/us-egypt-jazeera-idUSKCN0Q708B20150802 (Reuters)]  
;Politics and elections
*[[Bronwyn Bishop]] resigns as the [[Speaker of the Australian House of Representatives]] following an expenses scandal. [http://www.theaustralian.com.au/national-affairs/bronwyn-bishop-speaker-resigns-pm-launches-review-of-entitlements/story-fn59niix-1227466858302?utm_content=buffer4d2e8&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter.com&utm_campaign=buffer (''The Australian'')]
*[[Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Stephen Harper]] confirms he has asked [[Governor General of Canada|Governor General]] [[David Johnston]] to dissolve [[Parliament of Canada|the Canadian Parliament]] and set [[Canadian federal election, 2015|a general election]] for October 19th. This will be the longest election campaign for Canada in recent history, since voting was once staggered over months to accommodate people travelling from remote regions of the country using archaic means of transportation. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/canada-election-2015-stephen-harper-confirms-start-of-11-week-federal-campaign-1.3175136 (CBC)]
